post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: Who called. standard_customer: own appliance needs repair, no covered warranty. warranty_customer: own LG, Samsung or GE appliance under manufacturer's warranty. warranty_company: rep from a home warranty company. spam: sales, SEO, loans, robocalls, car extended warranty. other: wants a person, existing job, or anything else.

post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: booked: book_service_call returned booked. message_taken: a message or callback request was taken. fee_declined: the caller declined or was unsure about the $99 fee. incomplete: the call ended before intake was finished. dropped: the caller hung up early or the agent ended a spam call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: Caller's name as given. Empty if not given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: Callback number the caller confirmed or gave. Empty if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_address
post_call_analysis_data.description: Service address as confirmed. Empty if not given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appliance
post_call_analysis_data.description: Appliance type, e.g. dryer. Empty if not given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: brand
post_call_analysis_data.description: Appliance brand. Empty if not given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: issue
post_call_analysis_data.description: The problem in a few words. Empty if not given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: warranty_company
post_call_analysis_data.description: Home warranty company name, for warranty-company reps only. Empty otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: job_details
post_call_analysis_data.description: For warranty-company reps: homeowner, address, appliance, problem, and any claim or work-order number. Empty otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: Other useful details or questions the caller asked that the agent could not answer. Empty if none. Never invent anything.

post_call_analysis_data.name: warranty_mentioned
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller brought up a warranty of any kind.

post_call_analysis_data.name: fee_accepted
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the agent stated the $99 service call fee and the caller clearly accepted it.
